title: Modernize naming conventions
problem_statement: Legacy code uses outdated naming conventions that hinder readability and maintainability.
risk_if_unaddressed: Continued difficulty in maintaining and understanding code.
suggested_approach: Refactor all class and method names to use PascalCase.
success_criteria: All classes and methods follow PascalCase naming conventions.

title: Implement structured error handling
problem_statement: The codebase lacks structured error handling, which can lead to unhandled exceptions.
risk_if_unaddressed: Potential for unhandled exceptions and application crashes.
suggested_approach: Introduce try-catch blocks in all methods to handle exceptions gracefully.
success_criteria: All methods have appropriate try-catch blocks.
